goal: Construct a discriminating positive-mobility diffusion family and reconstruct which dynamic observations identify its parameters.
model: Conditional SU(2)^3 model from F1/F2: S=3x+y+z+w+t, rho_kappa=e^(kappa S)/Z, |kappa|<=1/8, c>0 in energy units, hbar>0; m_zeta=1+zeta x, |zeta|<1 is an explicitly introduced dynamics deformation. No identity to the original lattice Hamiltonian or measured time data is assumed. Treat kappa as known when calibrating c,zeta. No physical time-correlation observations are supplied.
required: Derive reversible divergence-form operator A=-rho^-1 div(rho m grad), its weighted Dirichlet form, zero mode and self-adjoint realization on compact SU2^3.
Derive full ground-state transform including grad(m) drift and kappa/2 div(m grad S) potential; retain shared-link Gamma(S) and cross terms from F2.
Prove a gap bound with the explicit mobility factor 1-|zeta| and alpha/E_star versus c/E_star distinction.
Show same static moments for all c,zeta. Derive initial imaginary-time correlation slopes for nonconstant observables. Synthetic values stay synthetic.
At kappa=0 compare f=x and g=x+x^2 with a parity-degenerate pair x,x^2. Derive exact Haar moments and identify c,zeta or prove rank failure.
Reject missing divergence drift, wrong mobility range, vanishing observable Dirichlet form and false physical matching. Use exact coefficient/rank fixtures, no optional Monte Carlo.

As a necessary matching test, compare principal symbols under same-coordinate multiplication ground-state conjugacy: nonconstant m_zeta cannot equal a constant-mobility rotor kinetic term. Do not assert that the physical infinite-lattice model reduces to this conditional three-link model.
acceptance: Verified conditional model discrimination and inverse map; physical matching remains unverified. K2 chosen from rank and conditioning evidence.
comparison_protocol: Use the standard report/check/output manifest with repo-relative inputs and output-relative outputs. Root can supply common comparison field names after independent reconstruction.
selection_reason: J2 constructs a genuine physical GNS generator, but no reduction to conditional three-link diffusion. K1 now tests this distinction with same-density/different-dynamics and principal-symbol controls.
